Hover adds one restrained coloured inner keyline and a modest metallic lift without bloom, electricity, flame, luminous cracks, sparkling highlights or rail-wide glow. Clicked uses darker recessed metal, a thin subdued keyline and slightly brighter corner points. Simplify to one primary metal rail plus a narrow inner bevel. Remove decorative cracks, repeated texture, gemstones, multiple luminous outlines and bright bands. Keep the central wells nearly black and calm for text.
